positions.description:
Hired to design and build an analytics platform for designers to use for game balance and engineers to use for operational monitoring.

Technologies: C++, Tableau,  UnrealScript, Unreal Engine, Backend Development, Data Manipulation & Presentation, AWS.

positions.title: Academy Instructor
positions.description: Responsible for teaching two Programming Academy sections (two week long, intensive overnight courses): iPad & iPhone App Development and iD Programming Labs 101.

positions.title: OS X Administrator, CSE Lab Assistant, Programming Tutor
positions.description:
Responsible for imaging, deploying, and maintaining an Apple iMac computer science lab coexisting alongside Windows systems. Heavily automated image creation & deployment via remote management tools.

Answers questions any students might have about languages and coding methodologies, especially the use of the bash command line, git, C++, Java, and C#. Responsible for keeping game development lab open to use during off-hours.

positions.title: Project Administrator
positions.description: One of four administrators for a twenty thousand user community playing the critically acclaimed game League of Legend. Leads the development team for custom Mac launcher iLoL, and coordinated development for a cross platform version of the same launcher alongside an active role as a software engineer. Project became defunct in October of 2013.

positions.title: iLoL Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a Mac OS X port of the much-acclaimed Windows game League of Legends using technologies like WINE and Cocoa. Current usage statistic include 671,000 downloads as well as 16,544,206 launches as of October 2012. Software engineer until project became defunct in October of 2013.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Team LED is an up-and-coming FIRST Tech Challenge robotics team founded by myself and two other students and sponsored by Southern Polytechnic State University. As a rookie team, they proved their worth in one of the most competitive states for FTC. As mentors, we taught a team of middle- to high-school students about STEM and engineering, especially how to apply those skills to become one of the best FTC teams in Georgia.

2013–2014 Team Awards:
NCCA Qualifier - 1st Place Inspire Award
NCCA Qualifier - 1st Place Alliance Parter
Wheeler High Qualifier - 5th Seed Overall
Wheeler High Qualifier - Connect Award
GA State Competition - 5th Seed Overall
GA State Competition - 2nd Place Alliance Partner
Southern Regional Competition - 7th Seed Overall

projects.title: Killing Floor 2
projects.description:
In KILLING FLOOR 2 players descend into continental Europe where the outbreak caused by Horzine Biotech’s failed experiment has quickly spread and gained unstoppable momentum, essentially paralyzing the European Union— Just one month after the events in the original KILLING FLOOR, the specimen clones are everywhere and civilization is in disarray; communications have failed, governments have collapsed, and military forces have been systematically eradicated. The people of Europe know survival and self-preservation too well and lucky survivors have gone into hiding. 

Not all have given up hope though... A group of civilians and mercenaries have banded together to combat the outbreak and established privately funded operation bases across Europe. Upon tracking specimen clone outbreaks, players will descend into zed-laden hot zones and exterminate them.

projects.title: Oculus Rift Research
projects.description: A research project using Unity and the Oculus Rift to test how the depth and stereoscopy the Rift gives affects gameplay
